info.title: LifeLine API (prototype)
info.description: Demo with synthetic data. Do not enter real health information. AI assists the care team. It does not diagnose or prescribe. A nurse or doctor decides. Course-project prototype; not clinically validated and not a medical product.

post.description: Issues the token. The outcome comes from the server-side triage decision for intake_id.

get.description: Confirm-screen preview: what we understood, in the patient's own words. No triage output.
Dashboard data: needs attention, present and waiting, booked not arrived, expected today (flagged), doctors.
Check-in desk: today's entries in this hospital by token label or name.
Patient drawer: 5-line summary, answers, vitals. Never diagnosis history or prescriptions.

post.description: Register a walk-in (no phone, no ID), issue a W token now, then run assisted intake.
Doctor calls a present patient in (marks 'with doctor'). Does not change anyone's queue position.

get.description: Search among THIS doctor's own patients (appointment relationship), with encounters this doctor wrote.
Policy-filtered: own encounters + (with consent) other doctors' Conditions only.
Only prescriptions from encounters this doctor authored; never other doctors' prescriptions.

ConsultationRequest.title: ConsultationRequest
ConsultationRequest.description: Typed by the doctor only. Nothing in this form is AI-suggested or autofilled.

IntakeAddendum.title: IntakeAddendum
IntakeAddendum.description: Short re-check (check-in "worse"/"new symptom") merged into an intake.
